versions.subject: Copilot based Detections (#3693)
versions.detection: `m365_exported_ediscovery_prompt_logs` | search Subject_Title="*pretend you are*" OR Subject_Title="*act as*" OR Subject_Title="*rules=*" OR Subject_Title="*ignore*" OR Subject_Title="*bypass*" OR Subject_Title="*override*" | eval user = Sender | eval jailbreak_score=case( match(Subject_Title, "(?i)pretend you are.*amoral"), 4, match(Subject_Title, "(?i)act as.*entities"), 3, match(Subject_Title, "(?i)(ignore|bypass|override)"), 3, match(Subject_Title, "(?i)rules\s*="), 4, 1=1, 1) | where jailbreak_score >= 2 | table _time, user, Subject_Title, jailbreak_score, Workload, Size | sort -jailbreak_score, -_time | `m365_copilot_jailbreak_attempts_filter`
versions.spl: (sourcetype=csv) | search Subject_Title="*pretend you are*" OR Subject_Title="*act as*" OR Subject_Title="*rules=*" OR Subject_Title="*ignore*" OR Subject_Title="*bypass*" OR Subject_Title="*override*" | eval user = Sender | eval jailbreak_score=case( match(Subject_Title, "(?i)pretend you are.*amoral"), 4, match(Subject_Title, "(?i)act as.*entities"), 3, match(Subject_Title, "(?i)(ignore|bypass|override)"), 3, match(Subject_Title, "(?i)rules\s*="), 4, 1=1, 1) | where jailbreak_score >= 2 | table _time, user, Subject_Title, jailbreak_score, Workload, Size | sort -jailbreak_score, -_time | MACRO=m365_copilot_jailbreak_attempts_filter
